subject: Installer: Claude CLI install+auth dependency + fix .mcp.json env-clobber + --headless-drains opt-in
description:
The headless judge drain spawns `claude -p`, so enabling ORCH_HEADLESS_DRAINS depends on the Claude Code CLI being installed AND authenticated. Build that dependency into bin/install.js. Context: note:note-mqgvjghmn2z, note:note-mqgqkxlboi0.

THREE PARTS (branch off main; flat task):
(a) CLAUDE CLI DETECTION: detect/verify the Claude Code CLI is installed (reuse resolveClaudeBin from lib/claude-cli.js) and, if cheap, that it's authenticated. Print a CLEAR WARNING if absent/unauthenticated — NOT a hard failure (the flag defaults off, so install must still succeed without the CLI).
(b) FIX installMcp ENV-CLOBBER (~bin/install.js:100): it currently sets `env: { ORCH_PORT: PORT }`, OVERWRITING the orchestrator-graph server's whole env on every reinstall — wiping ORCH_RERANK_ALPHA / ORCH_RERANK_K (and any ORCH_HEADLESS_DRAINS). MERGE instead: preserve existing/unknown env keys, set/refresh ORCH_PORT only.
(c) ADD --headless-drains OPT-IN: when the flag is passed to bin/install.js, write ORCH_HEADLESS_DRAINS=1 to BOTH .mcp.json env AND .claude/settings.json env (both daemon launch paths). Default (flag NOT passed): do NOT set ORCH_HEADLESS_DRAINS — headless drains stay OFF by default.

Tests: env-merge preserves existing keys across a reinstall; --headless-drains writes the flag to both files; a normal (no-flag) install does not set the flag; claude-absent warns rather than fails. ACCEPTANCE: all three parts + tests green; a normal install never enables headless drains; no changes outside bin/install.js (+ its test).
